An algorithm with no such file must come out clean. That is the default,

why: Three of the five are workarounds for IR features that do not exist yet,
F, E, R, D, Act -- a SEED written inside the cascade at a literal
generation 1, which the loop then writes again at i+1. The validator
reports it because an iterative rank passes through the constant.
Act joined this group on 2026-09. It used to be the other kind: E06
wrote Act_i every round and E19 wrote Act_{i+1}, so round i and round
i+1 wrote the same slice with neither being a seed -- and E06 was
recomputing what E19 had already written, identically, on every
comparable round. E06 is now pinned to generation 1 and seeds the
loop. The finding did not disappear, but it changed class, and 11
R -- E04 is a three-arm `cases`, and a lowered `cases` is three IR nodes
writing the same slice in order, each overwriting the last. That
ordering is what makes the u=s arm win. A later arm computing its
output's empty value cannot clear what an earlier arm wrote.
